summary: Comprehensive architectural plan to implement all 14 user requirements: header simplification with a categorized Career Tools dropdown, instant local account with saved profiles and resumes, 10-question multi-topic quizzes with roadmap recommendations, manual skill proficiency chips, interview prep for all roles, fixed Word/PDF 1-click downloads, enhanced GitHub profile auditing, expanded salary calculator with Indian cities and currency conversion, multi-format cover letter exports, culture fit overhaul, and refined light/dark themes.
